_readme: Creator Marketing and Partnerships, Version 1.4 with the Full Site Iteration V1 refinements (October 2026): the page's words and its media configuration, section by section (src/pages/work/creator-campaigns.astro and src/components/creator/). Version 1.4 is John's delta brief (October 2026) against the deployed Version 1.3: the program introduction becomes one centered editorial composition (the same headline, paragraph and roster line); the Singapore loop gives Eva's glasses shot a readable hold before Marina Bay and the Mykonos loop loses its two stray frames; the Trezor highlights read "2.2x" and are measured against the creator account's preceding posts (60, since Full Site Iteration V1), with no line calling them creator-account results; the library's destination films lose their two Club Zero shots, sponsor integrations lose Shiv's quick Trezor-box cuts, Podcasts no longer opens on the Lock In Podcast and game show loses a stray frame; and the credits name the eight creators by their X handles only. Everything else is Version 1.3 (and before it Version 1.2: the approved copy). Media slots name asset ids in src/data/assets.json; every slot already holds its final aspect ratio, all of them square or landscape. Full Site Iteration V1 (John's first full-site refinement brief, October 2026): the program paragraph wider, its roster line without a count and one emphasized phrase in it; John's Singapore line; the Trezor comparison against the creator account's preceding 60 posts (decided; the figures unchanged); Trezor's feedback centered, then a centered hairline before the library; no Selected content kicker and no changing caption under the frame; destination films giving John's moment after the cloud reveal its time; behind the scenes with a brief Lock In Podcast moment; and the team credits correcting who led travel, villas and trip logistics.

hero._hero: 05 Hero: one full-screen landscape composition in layers (the coastal-estate reference, used for the hero only): the sky, the headline, the villa and its palms in front of the headline's lower line, and two palm fronds at the corners, each moving at its own rate as the page scrolls, with a slow drift of their own; reduced motion holds the layers still. The photographs are illustrative stock (Unsplash), credited once, in the credits (V1.1), and never presented as footage from the trips. V1.2: the paragraph names John's ownership only; the collaborators are credited in the credits.
hero.label: 01 / Creator Marketing and Partnerships
hero.headline: Creator campaigns, built to travel.
hero.copy: I helped lead creator programs across Costa Rica, Singapore, and Mykonos, owning campaign strategy, creative direction, sponsor coordination, on-site production, and distribution.

context._context: 06 Program context (V1.4): no kicker; John's headline, its closing phrase in the accent, and one paragraph on what he led and helped plan, naming no collaborators (they are credited in the credits); beneath it `roster`, one smaller, quieter line on the eight creators and the fields they came from (no names, handles, pictures, follower counts, categories or travel histories). V1.4 sets the three as one centered editorial composition (the headline at the top center, the paragraph at a readable measure beneath it, then a short rule and the roster line) in place of V1.3's headline and paragraph side by side; the words are unchanged. No services grid and no list of roles. The section leads straight into the atlas. Full Site Iteration V1: the paragraph takes a wider measure (about 56rem, the same type), so it sets in fewer lines; `emphasis` is its one emphasized phrase (the site's paragraph emphasis, a slightly heavier weight); the roster line names no count.
context.headline: Each destination became a campaign in motion.
context.copy: For Bolt Liquidity, each trip brought creators, sponsors, and a production plan together for a few focused days. I led campaign strategy with co-sponsors, sponsor coordination, creative direction, on-site shoot planning, approvals, distribution, and reporting, and helped plan the travel, logistics, and production that made each activation possible.
context.emphasis: I led campaign strategy with co-sponsors
context.roster: The roster brought together creators across streaming, crypto media, ecosystem leadership, entertainment, and community.

atlas._atlas: 09 Campaign atlas: one stage that holds still while the reader scrolls through three states, Costa Rica, Singapore and Mykonos, each with its own loop (5 to 10 seconds, silent, landscape, reset with a dissolve), two fragments, color atmosphere, large name, chapter index and concise copy. Wide screens with motion allowed pin it; narrow or short screens, reduced motion and no JavaScript show the three chapters one after another. Counts: creators as the V1.0 roster counted them (6, 7 and 4), content pieces as John gave them in V1.1 (40+, 35+ and 25+). `sponsors` names logo ids in src/data/logos.json. V1.2: no visible kicker; `heading` names the section for assistive technology only (the unused V1.0 `title` is gone). V1.3: the Singapore loop is rebuilt around the city, the party-bus game show and high tea on the 56th floor (the girls photographing the food, its details, the creators at the table) with one shopping moment and no retail signage, and the Mykonos loop gains the aftermovie's Lock In Podcast production moment between the water and the villa; Costa Rica is unchanged. Full Site Iteration V1: John's Singapore line (the activation across the city, never a retail brand or its signage).

destinations.name: Costa Rica

trezor._trezor: 10 Trezor Dare Ad (V1.4): the final video first (Trezor Dare Ad.mp4, with sound, on request), then the assignment, the objective and the approach (John's words), three performance highlights from the creator's own account (V1.4: measured against the account's preceding 60 posts (Full Site Iteration V1, decided); "2.2x", heard by a screen reader as "2.2 times"; the third is #2 by reach, never most-viewed; never a raw total), set in the centered, display-scale composition of the Technical Product Marketing results (a centered label, one row of three, the percentile and `metricsNote` as quieter lines under it; V1.4 drops the sentence calling them creator-account results), and Trezor's feedback (since Full Site Iteration V1 centered as a whole, quotation, phrases and attribution, at a readable measure with balanced lines, then a centered hairline before the library; the approved quotation, one continuous quote whose four phrases, listed in `emphasis` and each found once in the quotation, are set apart by type alone: the deep teal and a slightly heavier weight, no marker). No collaboration block: the credits at the foot of the page keep that record.
trezor.title: Trezor Dare Ad
trezor.deck: A creator-led sponsor integration for Trezor, filmed at the creator house in Costa Rica.

brief.label: Assignment
brief.text: Create a creator-led campaign that places Trezor's new device inside a culturally relevant, community-driven moment rather than a conventional product demonstration.

brief.label: Objective
brief.text: Build affinity with crypto culture and community while highlighting the device's Bluetooth connectivity and refined, modern design.

brief.label: Approach
brief.text: Turn the product into the center of a playful dare filmed with creators at the Costa Rica house, using a real social setting to demonstrate wireless use, showcase the device's design, and make the integration feel native rather than ad-like.

trezor.metricsNote: Measured on the creator's account against its preceding 60 posts.

library._library: 11 Selected content (V1.4): a library of seven edits from across the three trips, one per format, each a curated mini-edit of its own (silent, landscape, 7 to 14 seconds) whose last moment dissolves back into its own opening, so it can repeat with no seam; chosen with simple text tabs and a restrained active line that fills as the edit plays. Until the reader chooses, with motion allowed, the library moves on to the next format as each edit ends, round and round (holding while keyboard focus is in the formats); a format the reader selects is pinned: its edit plays from the start and loops until they select another or leave the section (V1.3), after which the library moves on again. The reader can pause at any time; it pauses off screen and in a hidden tab. Reduced motion, a data-saving preference or a refused autoplay start nothing: the selected edit waits on its poster and plays through once on request. Without JavaScript the seven edits read in turn. V1.4: destination films without their Club Zero shots, sponsor integrations without Shiv's quick Trezor-box cuts, Podcasts opening on Jungle Talk with the Lock In Podcast in the middle, and game show without a stray frame. Full Site Iteration V1: no kicker above the headline, and no line under the frame naming the format and the place (the tabs already say which format is playing), so the edits carry no cue times; the pause control stays at the lower right. Destination films give John's moment after the cloud reveal into Mykonos its time, and behind the scenes keeps the Lock In Podcast to one brief production angle.
library.headline: One program, many formats.
library.copy: See the program move from destination films and creator ads to sponsor integrations and the moments behind the camera.
library.label: Formats

ownership._ownership: 12 Program ownership (V1.3): John's working headline, its first sentence above a waterline and its second below it (V1.2's more prominent wave and its swell, which since V1.3 flow again: each layer travels to the left at its own slow, even pace, without end and without a visible reset, the swell slower than the wave; still for reduced motion), one line on his role and three editorial chapters of his own work: shaping the campaign, directing the production and carrying it to market. No collaborators named here (the credits name them), no list of areas, no rings, no cards or pills, and nothing John did not do (no creator sourcing, legal contracts, solo filming or editing, or sole ownership of travel logistics).
ownership.headline: The experience was visible. The system behind it was not.
ownership.below: The system behind it was not.
ownership.copy: My role connected the campaign from sponsor strategy and creative direction through on-site production, distribution, and reporting.

credits._credits: 13 Credits: one system for everyone who made the work, set like a film's closing credits. The team first (V1.1): John Cowin, Maanav Porwal and Bob van der Meer, each with what they owned or collaborated on, word for word from John's brief; then the eight creators by their public X handles only (V1.4, `handles`, in place of V1.3's names and affiliations: no employers, partnerships, projects, descriptors, follower counts or travel histories; plain text, no links, icons or cards), the co-sponsors, the brand and the hero's illustrative photography (credited here only). Since V1.2 the only place on the page that names individual collaborators, and since V1.3 the only place the creators appear. Nothing implies John edited, shot or designed the work. Full Site Iteration V1: John co-led the program planning, travel, villas and trip logistics, which are no longer Maanav's alone, and the line on on-site ownership varying by activation is gone.
credits.title: Many hands, one program.

conclusion._conclusion: 14 The conclusion: one short idea (the program kept working after each trip), then the way on to the next case study in order (Technical Product Marketing), then the shared Contact section.
conclusion.headline: The trip ends. The program keeps working.
conclusion.copy: Each activation produced an immediate body of campaign content and strengthened the creator and partner relationships behind the next opportunity. The value continued through distribution, reporting, and ongoing collaboration after everyone went home.
conclusion.nextLine: Next, see how I turn technical complexity into a clear market narrative.
